movements.notes: half-marathon distance; this event scores the full finish

origin.summary: An event from the 2013 CrossFit Games. The CrossFit Games are the season's final championship stage, where the qualified field competes across multiple events to crown the Fittest on Earth. Games events are tests first and workouts second — many use loads, formats, or venues no affiliate would program, which is exactly why they make interesting benchmarks.

description: The same half-marathon row as Row 1, scored instead at the full finish.
source_notes: games.crossfit.com/workouts/games/2013/7 (official CrossFit Games event), retrieved 2026-07-09; time cap 2 hours (men) / 2 hours 10 minutes (women); same continuous row as Row 1, scored at the full 21,097 m finish
